svg.title: ST185 OEM junction - J/B No.1 - left kick panel
svg.text: OEM junction block, KEPT (DECISIONS R12 / R61). We splice into the factory leads of three plugs: 1I (always-hot), 1H, 1F. Cabin side of the lead, left kick panel (EWD 1993 p.18-19, p.46, p.62).
TAIL 15A out (TAIL relay, light switch TAIL/HEAD) -> rear tail lamps R11 / R12 pins 2-3, license L1 pin 1
crimp butt splice into the factory 1F-1 lead at J/B1 (cabin side, left kick; the rear floor
-> Tail splice - J/B 1 TAIL feed to R11 / R12 pins 2 and 3 and L1
turn RH out (flasher T3 via H5 / C15) -> R12 pin 6
crimp butt splice into the factory 1F-2 lead at J/B1 (cabin side, left kick; the rear floor
-> RH rear lamp R12 pin 6, socket pigtail - turn RH (EWD 1993 p.130)
turn LH out (flasher T3 via H5 / C15) -> R11 pin 6
crimp butt splice into the factory 1F-3 lead at J/B1 (cabin side, left kick; the rear floor
-> LH rear lamp R11 pin 6, socket pigtail - turn LH (EWD 1993 p.130)
crimp butt splice into the factory 1H-2 lead at J/B1 (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> LOGIC box Bus 1 pin 5 (glove box; CabinPower) - DOME 20 A fuse out
crimp butt splice into the factory 1H-4 lead at J/B1 (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> LH front turn / clearance lamp F7 pin 3 - turn + (EWD p.130)
WIPER 20A out -> front wiper motor F9 pin 4 (+B to the park switch)
crimp butt splice into the factory 1H-5 lead at J/B1 (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Front wiper motor F9 pin 4 (cowl, driver side) - +B (EWD p.148)
TAIL 15A out (TAIL relay) -> front clearance F7 / F8 pin 1
crimp butt splice into the factory 1H-6 lead at J/B1 (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> Clearance feed split - F7 LH + F8 RH
solder splice onto the factory lead
-> ECU-B (Link G4X plug B, centre dash) pin B28
IG2 -> supply diode -> ECU-A A5 (ECU wake feed, channels.csv b28 note, DECISIONS item 38)
solder splice onto the factory lead
crimp butt splice into the factory 1H-8 lead at J/B1 (cabin side; engine-room main removed)
-> RH front turn / clearance lamp F8 pin 3 - turn + (EWD p.130)
J/B1 primary B+ (always hot; was FL ALT)
heavy crimp butt splice into the factory 1I-1 lead
-> POWER box AMI OUT pin 5 (glove box; CabinPower) - J/B1 60 A fuse out
OEM box: only the plugs / cavities we splice are drawn
Generated by docs/build/wiring-diagrams/build_wiring_diagrams.py from docs/harness/interfaces.json (flyingLeads); wire facts from the looms. Every cavity not shown stays factory.
Splice dot = our wire butt-spliced into the factory lead. Wire label: wire id | gauge | insulation colour (ident bands). Far end: DECISIONS R156 form.
